qa.label: QA
qa.warning: QA is for controlled testing. Keep its profile and credential file separate from production.

dev.label: Development
dev.warning: Development is for Realinsight development and approved testing. Keep it isolated from QA and production.

guardrails: Native desktop app instructions are the default when the harness provides a documented desktop path.
CLI instructions are explicit alternatives for Codex, Claude Code, and CLI-first MCP harnesses.
Copyable command and configuration templates are machine-readable under copy_templates.
Remote HTTP MCP is the default installation path.
Local Node MCP runs checked-in source from a clone.
The native Realinsight toolkit package is not yet available through npm or npx.
Non-production profiles and credential files must stay isolated.
Realinsight APIs enforce the signed-in user's customer context, permissions, and scopes.
